captureMethod.tap: AudioEngine masterGain -> ScriptProcessorNode -> zero-gain sink -> AudioContext.destination
captureMethod.detector: Stage B hysteresis scanner; HI=0.2, LO=0.05, quiet re-arm=10 ms

design.onlyPatternConditionChange: Pattern.lengthSteps and the matching zero-padded channel.steps storage length
design.effects: no channel FX; identical master engine state; capture tapped at masterGain before the master output chain
design.interleaving: strict round-robin, 16-step then 32-step on every adjacent pair; no blocked condition runs

measurement.productionPath: audioEngine.play() -> production AudioClockTransport -> production triggerCurrentStep() -> MiniSynth voice
measurement.tap: AudioEngine masterGain -> ScriptProcessorNode -> zero-gain sink -> AudioContext.destination
measurement.onsetDetector: Stage B hysteresis scanner; HI=0.2, LO=0.05, quiet re-arm=10 ms
measurement.primary: N0 - N8 differential in ms = (scheduledStep8 - scheduledStep0) - (observedOnset8 - observedOnset0)
exclusions: step 0 or step 8 trigger count not exactly one
one or more dropped capture buffers
capture chunks not all 4096 samples or mean chunk step differs from 4096
measurement.bundleStartLeadMedianGate: diagnostic only; median scheduledStep0-tCall must be near 30 ms for each pattern length; never used to exclude an otherwise valid run
